definitions.explanation: On the same day as another event or action; immediately without delay.

examples.japanese: {即日|そくじつ}⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧{即日|そくじつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: You can use it from the same day you apply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{即日|そくじつ}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦されます→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The results will be announced on the same day.

notes:
{即日|そくじつ} emphasizes that something happens on the very same day as another event, with no waiting period. Often used as a noun modifier before another noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即日|そくじつ}⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧: same-day delivery
- {即日|そくじつ}⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧: same-day shipping
- {即日|そくじつ}⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧: same-day response
- {即日|そくじつ}⟦{開票|かいひょう}→開票：19117_kaihyou⟧: same-day vote counting
- {即日|そくじつ}⟦{完売|かんばい}→完売：18954_kanbai⟧: sold out on the same day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧: on that day, the day in question (neutral — does not emphasize speed)
- ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧: today (formal, used in announcements)
- {即日|そくじつ} specifically highlights the speed or immediacy, implying no delay

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in business, advertising, and official announcements. In casual speech, ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (within that day) is more natural.
